76:t_013:9.en:
$$柿小路$$
「But $$勝平$$, did you and the others know we were here?」

76:t_013:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sort of. My dad heard some news about the $$残されの海$$.」

76:t_013:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah, that's right. My family... the whole $$神ファミリー$$ is on this Earth.」

76:t_013:13.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$勝平$$'s father is the captain of a deep-sea fishing boat, but...」

76:t_013:14.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Over the radio with his friends at sea, he picked up a story that a warship and robots came to the $$残されの海$$ and fought pirates.」

76:t_013:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「So I figured they had to be friends from 《$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$》 and 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》, and I made the trip all the way here in $$ザンボット３$$.」

76:t_013:16.en:
$$恵子$$
「Hey, $$勝平$$...! You're supposed to tell them the important part!」

76:t_013:18.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We were entrusted with a message from $$万丈$$ about the coming fight against the $$サイデリアル$$.」

76:t_013:20.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The much-talked-about dashing fellow, $$破嵐万丈$$...」

76:t_013:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What could that message possibly be...」

76:t_100:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Request an explanation of the situation.」

76:t_100:1.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are an enemy of the Alliance. Since they are the ones attacking, intercepting them is the obvious call.」

76:t_100:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Question. Until recently, you recognized yourself as worthless as a soldier of the Alliance.」

76:t_100:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Why, then, do you now attempt to fulfill the duties of an Alliance soldier?」

76:t_100:4.en:
$$レド$$
「...I'll think about that answer from now on.」

76:t_100:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Then you ordered this unit to fight without any firm basis for judgment or sense of purpose?」

76:t_100:6.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll think about that answer from now on too!」

76:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I knew it...! He's the new 《$$スフィア・リアクター$$》!」

76:t_101:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! The enemy seems to have identified us as a Reactor!」

76:t_101:2.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$ was one of them. It's only natural, when you think about it.」

76:t_101:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Those people... are they avenging their comrade...?」

76:t_101:4.en:
$n
「I couldn't care less about their circumstances. There's only one thing I'm going to do...」

76:t_101:5.en:
$n
「Make them realize who the current owner of the $$スフィア$$ that used to be their weapon is, and that this person is the worst enemy they could have!」

76:t_102:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's $$ザンボット３$$ for you, loaded with one of $$ビアル星$$'s ion engines! The power is on a whole different level than before!」

76:t_102:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「$$勝平$$! Don't let that power throw you around!」

76:t_102:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「Don't forget that we came here to represent the $$神ファミリー$$!」

76:t_102:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「I know, I know! Both the $$サイデリアル$$ making everybody suffer, and that weird robot army...」

76:t_102:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Me and $$ザンボット３$$ will take them all on at once!!」

76:t_103:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm not letting $$勝平$$ beat me! $$トライダーＧ７$$ and I are going in too!!」

76:t_103:1.en:
$$郁絵$$
「President... you seem happy to see $$勝平$$ and the others again.」

76:t_103:2.en:
$$厚井$$
「He looked awfully lonely when $$勝平$$ and the others went back to the $$ＵＣＷ$$, after all.」

76:t_103:3.en:
$$木下$$
「It's as if the flower of friendship has burst into bloom!」

76:t_103:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「With them here, we're worth a hundred men! We'll follow their lead!!」

76:t_103:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's go, robot army! Don't think you can stop us now!!」
